summary: Keep macOS browser helper socket paths below the native length limit and document platform-selected installation.
reason: The downstream browser helper repeats the generated session name in a Unix socket path. Native macOS launches failed before navigation when that path exceeded 103 bytes, while the CLI reported a lost browser. Short identifiers and a unique private /tmp socket directory avoid home/TMPDIR length dependence. Windows keeps its native connection handling and separate release binary.
validated_outcome: The old generated name fails the socket-length regression. The repaired native macOS helper opens, probes, and closes a blank browser using a synthetic long home/runtime path without visiting Zapier. Private socket-directory permissions and cleanup are asserted. Release publication requires separate macOS browser and Windows PowerShell gates. README and standalone install prompts match.
